title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Proven Loss and the Invoice Value of Affected Packages
content:
Under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`, the settlement of every kind of loss other than delay loss starts from the Proven Loss. This page defines that Proven Loss and the invoice value that limits it.

## Scope

The definition below governs the settlement of all kinds of loss except delay loss. Delay losses keep their own ceilings, and the invoice value limit set out here does not apply to them.

## Definition

The Proven Loss is the amount claimed, except that it can never exceed the commercial invoice value of the affected packages.

The **commercial invoice value of the affected packages** is taken from the transport document that the line holds, for the cover holder, on the booking the cover protects. Take the declared cargo value printed on that document, divide it by the document's package count, multiply by the count of packages affected, and round to the cent.

Where no transport document carrying a declared cargo value and a package count is recorded for the cover holder on that booking, the Proven Loss is the amount claimed as it stands.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Transport document on record | Comparison | Proven loss |
|---|---|---|
| carries a declared cargo value and a package count | amount claimed higher than the invoice value of the affected packages | the invoice value of the affected packages |
| carries a declared cargo value and a package count | amount claimed equal to or lower than that invoice value | the amount claimed |
| none recorded for the cover holder, or no declared cargo value | none | the amount claimed |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

The transport document shows a declared cargo value of 96000.00 USD for 400 packages, and 30 packages are affected. The invoice value of the affected packages is 96000.00 divided by 400, multiplied by 30, which gives 7200.00 USD.

- If 8100.00 USD is claimed, the Proven Loss is 7200.00.
- If 6500.00 USD is claimed, the Proven Loss is 6500.00.
